stories.title: Apple Cuts Over 200 Jobs From Siri and Vision Pro Teams
stories.summary: Apple has laid off more than 200 employees across its Vision Pro and Siri software teams, according to Engadget, TechCrunch, and The Verge. The cuts hit staff working on the voice assistant and the mixed-reality headset. None of the reports give a stated reason from Apple.
stories.whyItMatters: The cuts touch two of Apple's most closely watched bets, an overdue Siri overhaul and its mixed-reality push, raising questions about their priority inside the company.
whatToWatch: Whether Apple comments publicly on the layoffs
Any change to the Siri revamp or Vision Pro product timeline
questions: Why did Apple cut these teams specifically?
